Method of Attack: Information stealing malware targeting Intel-based macOS computers
Steals passwords, files, and app data including keychain, Telegram, and Meta (Facebook) services
Exfiltrates data via TCP over port 3000
Delivered via social engineering phishing emails with password-protected zip files containing DMG disk images
Malicious executables disguised as PDF files inside mounted disk images
Attack Vector: Disk image files (DMGs) attached to emails containing disguised malicious executables
Indicators of Compromise: Disk image files named after Adobe software or client work, e.g., 'Advertising terms of reference (MacOS presentation).dmg', 'Adobe Photoshop 2023 (with AI) installer.dmg', 'Brief_Presentation-Task_Overview-(SOW)-PlayersClub.dmg'
Presence of Info.plist, Resources folder with icon image, and macOS folder with Mach-O executable in application bundles
